name: Spare Ride
replaces: Uber (rides), plus the taxi booking apps and phone booking lines people use today
summary: A ride-hailing app owned by its members, with drivers voting on its fares and rules: riders see an upfront fare and where every dollar goes, and drivers keep everything except the at-cost fee they vote on. It runs on the shared marketplace loop in the kit and adds only what rides need: dispatch by road time, fares, live trips, safety, accessibility and the passenger transport rules.

areas.name: Rider accounts and getting started
areas.summary: How a rider joins, signs in, sets up their profile and preferences, and closes their account, using the one Spareware login.

features.name: Sign up in a minute
features.does: A rider creates an account with a passkey, a phone code or an email and can book straight away.

parts.name: Rider sign-up screens
parts.what: Screens to sign up with the shared Spareware login, passkey first, phone code or email as fallback.

parts.name: Phone number check
parts.what: Confirms the rider's phone with a one-time code so drivers and support can reach them.

parts.name: Rider record
parts.what: The rider's profile, settings and status, stored as operations on their Spareware account.

parts.name: Registered passenger details
parts.what: Keeps the details the passenger service rules ask for, so every app rider counts as a registered passenger.

parts.name: Minimum rider age
parts.what: The youngest age a rider may hold an account, checked at sign-up on the kit's minimum age rule without collecting more than it needs.

features.name: Sign in on any device
features.does: A rider signs in on a new phone or in a browser and finds their places, settings and history waiting.

parts.name: Sign-in and recovery screens
parts.what: Passkey sign-in with a code fallback and a safe account recovery path.

parts.name: Settings sync
parts.what: Saved places, preferences and trip history follow the rider to every device.

features.name: Profile
features.does: A rider sets the name drivers see, an optional photo and their language.

parts.name: Profile screen
parts.what: Edit name, photo and language, with a preview of what a driver sees once they have accepted the trip, and never before.

parts.name: Photo check
parts.what: Checks an uploaded photo shows a face and is not offensive before drivers see it, within the limits the biometrics assessment sets.

features.name: Saved places
features.does: A rider saves home, work and favourite places and picks them in one tap.

parts.name: Saved places store
parts.what: A rider's named places with their exact pickup point, kept private to the rider.

parts.name: Saved places screen
parts.what: Add, rename, reorder and delete saved places.

features.name: Ride preferences
features.does: A rider sets standing preferences such as a quiet ride, help with bags, temperature and accessibility needs.

parts.name: Rider preferences
parts.what: The rider's standing preferences and accessibility needs, kept on their profile.

parts.name: Rider preferences screen
parts.what: Simple toggles for each preference, with plain notes on what drivers see.

features.name: First ride guide
features.does: A new rider sees a short guide to the upfront fare, the at-cost fee and the safety tools before their first trip.

parts.name: First ride guide
parts.what: Three or four short screens on the kit's first-run guide, which can be skipped and found again in help.

features.name: Change or close an account
features.does: A rider changes their details, pauses their account or closes it for good.

parts.name: Account settings
parts.what: Change phone, email, passkeys and language, with a list of signed-in devices.

parts.name: Close account screen
parts.what: Pause or close the account from settings, showing any balance, ride credit or open dispute first, then hand over to Ride's deletion rules.

features.name: Invite a friend
features.does: A rider shares an invite link so friends can join; paid sign-up bonuses exist only if members vote for them.

parts.name: Ride invites
parts.what: Invite links that open Spare Ride's sign-up, on the kit's invites, with any sign-up bonus set only by a members' vote.

features.name: Visiting New Zealand
features.does: A visitor signs up with an overseas phone number or email, pays with a card from home, sees the higher overseas card fee before booking and uses the app in their own language.

parts.name: Overseas sign-up
parts.what: Sign-up with an overseas phone number or an email, offering email or a passkey first and limiting texted codes to overseas numbers with the kit's text cost guard against SMS pumping.

parts.name: Overseas card fee
parts.what: Shows the higher payment fee on overseas cards, passed through at cost, in the fare breakdown before the rider books.

parts.name: Visitor's language
parts.what: Opens the app in the phone's language where a translation exists, with the languages most visitors to NZ speak translated first.

areas.name: Driver sign-up and checks
areas.summary: How a person becomes a driver: applying, proving their licence, identity, vehicle and insurance, setting up payouts, joining the co-op and staying checked.

features.name: Apply to drive
features.does: A person applies to drive from a phone or a browser, sees every requirement up front and tracks their progress.

parts.name: Application screens
parts.what: A step-by-step application that saves as it goes and can be finished later.

parts.name: Application record
parts.what: Each application and every check result, stored as operations so the history is clear.

parts.name: Progress tracker
parts.what: Shows which checks are done, waiting or failed, and what to do next.

parts.name: Driver requirements list
parts.what: Every licence, check and document a driver needs in NZ, with the source for each.

features.name: Licence and P endorsement check
features.does: An applicant proves they hold a full driver licence and a P (passenger) endorsement, checked against the official record.

parts.name: Licence check
parts.what: Checks licence class, status and endorsements against the official register through an approved verification route.

parts.name: Endorsement rules
parts.what: Encodes what a valid P endorsement is and when it lapses, so the app never lets an unendorsed driver online.

parts.name: Drivers with their own operator licence
parts.what: Lets drivers who hold their own small passenger service licence record it, which changes what records they keep.

features.name: Identity check
features.does: An applicant proves who they are with photo ID and a live selfie, checked by a regulated verification provider.

parts.name: Driver identity step
parts.what: Places the kit's identity check in the driver application and keeps the verified photo for later right-driver checks, as the biometrics assessment allows.

parts.name: Verification provider choice
parts.what: Which of the kit's identity providers can also run the live selfie match drivers need, and on what terms.

features.name: Vehicle check
features.does: An applicant adds their vehicle and its registration, Certificate of Fitness, age and seats are checked.

parts.name: Vehicle record
parts.what: Each vehicle's plate, make, model, colour, seats, fuel type, equipment and document expiries.

parts.name: Vehicle photos
parts.what: The applicant uploads photos of the vehicle and plate for a reviewer to check.

parts.name: Vehicle rules
parts.what: Decides which ride options a vehicle can offer from its seats, age, fuel type and equipment, set per city.

parts.name: Licence label per vehicle
parts.what: Issues each approved vehicle a small passenger service licence label under the co-op's licence, records which label is in which vehicle, checks a photo that it is in the front windscreen above the registration label, and takes it back when the vehicle leaves.

features.name: Insurance
features.does: An applicant shows their vehicle is insured for carrying passengers, or joins cover the co-op arranges.

parts.name: Insurance options
parts.what: What cover passengers, drivers and the co-op need and who in NZ offers it.

parts.name: Insurance proof
parts.what: Upload of the policy with its expiry date, checked by a reviewer.

features.name: Payout and tax details
features.does: An applicant adds a bank account for payouts, their IRD number and whether they are GST-registered.

parts.name: Payout account set-up
parts.what: Puts the kit's payout set-up into the driver application, so bank details go to the regulated payment provider and never to Spareware.

parts.name: Tax details
parts.what: IRD number and GST status, stored so the GST engine and income reports are correct.

parts.name: Driver account protection
parts.what: Every driver uses a second sign-in step, and a change to payout bank details waits behind the kit's payout change guard.

features.name: Join the co-op
features.does: An applicant becomes a member of the co-op and agrees to the driver agreement written in plain words.

parts.name: Driver member step
parts.what: Folds the co-op's member sign-up into the application.

parts.name: Driver agreement
parts.what: The agreement between driver and co-op, on the kit's contractor agreements if drivers are contractors, written once the status decision is made.

parts.name: Agreement in drivers' languages
parts.what: Plain translations of the driver agreement in the languages many drivers speak, so every driver understands what they sign, which the unfair contract terms rules for small trade contracts weigh.

parts.name: Non-discrimination commitment
parts.what: Each driver accepts the kit's non-discrimination commitment at sign-up, written for rides: never refusing, cancelling on or rating down a rider on any ground the Human Rights Act 1993 protects.

parts.name: Signing the agreement
parts.what: The driver signs the agreement with the kit's signatures and audit trail and keeps a signed copy, so there is a written agreement as the gateway test asks.

features.name: Orientation
features.does: A new driver completes a short orientation on safety, accessibility, assistance animals, work time limits and the app before their first trip.

parts.name: Orientation content
parts.what: Short lessons and a quiz on safety, accessibility, assistance animals, work time limits, caring for intoxicated or vulnerable riders, spotting human trafficking and the app, in English and te reo Māori first, then in the languages many drivers speak, such as Hindi, Punjabi, Mandarin, Samoan and Tongan.

parts.name: Orientation course
parts.what: Runs the orientation as a course on the kit's training and certificates, and unlocks going online once it is passed.

parts.name: Children riding alone
parts.what: What a driver does when a child turns up to ride alone before teen accounts exist: decline with no penalty, tell the account holder and the safety team through the app, and never drive off leaving the child somewhere unsafe.

features.name: Reviewer approval
features.does: A co-op reviewer checks anything the automatic checks cannot and approves or explains a refusal.

parts.name: Review hand-off
parts.what: Sends applications that need a person to the document review queue with every check result attached.

parts.name: Refusal reasons
parts.what: Every refusal names the rule it rests on and how to fix it or appeal.

features.name: Expiry reminders and re-checks
features.does: A driver is reminded before any document expires and is paused, not removed, if a check lapses.

parts.name: Expiry reminders
parts.what: Push, email and text reminders at set times before expiry.

parts.name: Ongoing licence checks
parts.what: Re-checks licence and endorsement status on a schedule the law allows.

features.name: More than one vehicle
features.does: A driver adds several vehicles and picks which one they drive today.

parts.name: Vehicle switcher
parts.what: Choose today's vehicle before going online; only checked vehicles appear.

features.name: Stop driving and leave the co-op
features.does: A driver who stops driving gets their last payout, settles any balance either way, has their share repaid and takes their record with them.

parts.name: Driver exit
parts.what: Ends the driver role, makes the last payout, settles any money owed either way and keeps tax statements available after they leave.

parts.name: Share repaid
parts.what: Redeems the driver's member share when they leave, unless they choose to stay a member.

parts.name: Take my driving record
parts.what: Exports the driver's ratings, trip count and checks passed as a signed file another platform or a lender can verify.

parts.name: Unclaimed payouts
parts.what: Payouts that cannot be delivered after a driver leaves, and dormant ride credit, are recorded and, if the co-op rather than the payment provider holds them, paid to Inland Revenue under the Unclaimed Money Act 1971, which is unverified.

features.name: Help getting a P endorsement
features.does: A person who wants to drive but has no P endorsement follows a step-by-step guide and tracks each step.

parts.name: P endorsement guide
parts.what: Steps for the medical, the fit and proper check and the application, with links to the official forms and a progress tracker.

features.name: Right to work checked
features.does: An applicant on a visa shows they may drive in NZ, and is checked again before their visa lapses.

parts.name: Driver visa check
parts.what: Runs the kit's visa entitlement check in the application, records the entitlement and its expiry, and checks again before it lapses, pausing offers rather than removing the driver.

parts.name: Visa conditions for driving
parts.what: Which visa conditions allow driving for Spare Ride as a contractor or as a co-op employee, so a visa tied to another employer or one that bars self-employment is caught.

features.name: Bring in drivers and help each other
features.does: A driver invites people to drive and talks with other drivers in a forum.

parts.name: Driver referral
parts.what: Invite links to apply to drive, with any referral reward set only by a members' vote.

parts.name: Driver forum
parts.what: A Spare Ride space on the kit's member forum where drivers help each other and raise ideas for votes.

features.name: Cover for lost income
features.does: A driver joins an optional group policy, arranged by the co-op at cost, that pays part of their income when sickness or injury stops them driving.

parts.name: Income protection option
parts.what: Whether insurers offer drivers an optional group income protection policy at cost, what it covers and what it costs.

areas.name: Booking a ride
areas.summary: Everything a rider does before the car is on its way: where to, where from, which kind of car, the upfront fare, booking now or later, and cancelling.

features.name: Where to
features.does: A rider types or picks a destination and sees matching addresses and places as they type.

parts.name: Destination search box
parts.what: Search-as-you-type over addresses, places and saved places, with recent trips first.

parts.name: Recent places
parts.what: The rider's last destinations, kept on the account and cleared when they ask.

features.name: Pickup point
features.does: A rider confirms where to be picked up from their location or a pin, snapped to a safe, legal stopping spot.

parts.name: Pickup pin
parts.what: A draggable pin on the map that shows the suggested stopping spot and a short description.

parts.name: Location permission handling
parts.what: Asks for location only while booking, explains why, and works by typing if refused.

parts.name: Walk to the pickup
parts.what: Shows the rider a walking route, distance and time from where they are to the pickup spot the app moved them to.

features.name: Choose a ride option
features.does: A rider compares ride options such as standard, larger, premium, electric, pet-friendly, wheelchair accessible and taxi, each with fare and wait time.

parts.name: Ride option catalogue
parts.what: The list of ride options per city, each with its vehicle rules and fare formula.

parts.name: Ride option list
parts.what: Shows each option with its upfront fare, wait time and seats, and hides options with no driver nearby.

parts.name: Passengers and bags
parts.what: The rider says how many people and bags are coming; options without enough seats or space are hidden and the driver sees the numbers on the offer.

features.name: Upfront fare and where it goes
features.does: A rider sees the full fare before booking and how it splits between driver, running cost, payment fee and GST.

parts.name: Fare card
parts.what: Shows the upfront fare and taps open to show the breakdown and the formula version used.

parts.name: Quote hold
parts.what: Keeps a quoted fare valid for a few minutes so it does not change while the rider decides.

features.name: Book now
features.does: A rider confirms and the request goes out to drivers straight away.

parts.name: Ride request command
parts.what: The request as one command on the marketplace loop, so people, AI and scripts book the same way.

parts.name: Ride state machine
parts.what: The states a ride moves through, from requested to matched, arriving, on trip, completed or cancelled.

parts.name: Booking screen
parts.what: Confirm, then a clear searching state with the option to cancel.

features.name: Note for the driver
features.does: A rider adds a pickup note such as a gate code or which door.

parts.name: Pickup note
parts.what: A short note sent with the request and shown on the driver's offer and pickup screen.

features.name: Schedule ahead
features.does: A rider books a ride for a set time up to a set number of days ahead.

parts.name: Scheduled booking record
parts.what: The scheduled ride with its pickup time, fare and reminders.

parts.name: Schedule picker
parts.what: Pick a date and time, see the fare and the latest time to cancel free.

parts.name: Hold timing for scheduled rides
parts.what: Checks the card when a ride is booked ahead and places the hold close to pickup time, so it never runs past the card's hold limit.

features.name: Several stops
features.does: A rider adds one or more stops on the way, each shown to the driver in order.

parts.name: Multi-stop routing
parts.what: Routes and prices a trip through several stops in order.

parts.name: Stops editor
parts.what: Add, reorder and remove stops before or during booking.

features.name: Book for someone else
features.does: A rider books for a friend or family member, who gets the driver and car details by text.

parts.name: Guest rider details
parts.what: Name and phone of the person riding, used only for this trip.

parts.name: Guest trip text
parts.what: Sends the guest a text with the driver, car and a live trip link, and a short notice of the details shared about them.

features.name: Cancel a booking
features.does: A rider cancels free inside a published window, and sees any fee before confirming a later cancellation.

parts.name: Cancel flow
parts.what: Shows whether cancelling is free or what it costs, then cancels in one tap.

features.name: Ask for the same driver again
features.does: A rider asks a driver they liked for a future booking, and the driver chooses whether to take it.

parts.name: Favourite drivers
parts.what: A rider's list of drivers to offer scheduled trips to first, on the kit's favourites, which drivers can switch off.

features.name: Move the pickup point
features.does: A rider moves their pickup point a short way before the car arrives, and the driver is told at once.

parts.name: Pickup change
parts.what: Moves the pickup within a set distance, tells and re-routes the driver, and re-quotes the fare only if the change is large.

features.name: Check a fare without an account
features.does: Anyone enters two places and sees the upfront fare and where every dollar goes, without signing up.

parts.name: Public fare estimator
parts.what: A public page that quotes a trip and shows its breakdown, with limits that stop it being used to track drivers.

features.name: Wait longer, pay less
features.does: A rider who can wait longer for a driver picks a cheaper option.

parts.name: Wait and save option
parts.what: A ride option with a longer wait and a lower fare, with the discount and the wait set by the drivers' vote.

areas.name: More ways to ride
areas.summary: Trip types beyond one rider going from A to B: shared rides, hire by the hour, parcels, airports and events, long trips between towns, links to public transport and child seats.

features.name: Airport and event pickups
features.does: A rider at an airport or a big event goes to a clear pickup zone, and drivers wait in a fair first-in, first-out queue.

parts.name: Pickup queue
parts.what: A first-in, first-out driver queue for a zone, with rules drivers can read.

parts.name: Airport access and fees
parts.what: What each airport charges and requires of ride-hailing drivers, and the agreements needed.

parts.name: Event pickup zones
parts.what: Temporary pickup zones and queues set up by the operations team for big events.

features.name: Shared rides
features.does: Riders going the same way share a car and each pays less.

parts.name: Pooling methods
parts.what: How proven open projects and papers match shared rides, and whether riders in NZ cities would use them.

parts.name: Shared ride rules
parts.what: Ride's detour limits, seat counts and pickup order for grouping requests with the kit's batching.

parts.name: Shared ride fare
parts.what: Splits the fare between riders fairly, set by the drivers' vote.

parts.name: Shared trip screens
parts.what: Show riders and the driver who is picked up and dropped off in what order.

features.name: Hire by the hour
features.does: A rider books a car and driver for a number of hours with several stops.

parts.name: Hourly fare rule
parts.what: A fare per hour with included kilometres, set by vote.

parts.name: Hourly booking screen
parts.what: Pick start time, hours and rough plan; extend while the hire is running.

features.name: Send a parcel
features.does: A person sends a small parcel with a driver, with no passenger, and the recipient confirms with a code.

parts.name: Parcel rules
parts.what: What items drivers may carry, insurance, and whether the passenger service licence covers parcels.

parts.name: Parcel booking
parts.what: Book a parcel trip with sender and recipient details and a size.

parts.name: Handover code
parts.what: The recipient gives the driver a code, using the kit's handover codes, so delivery is confirmed.

features.name: Long trips between towns
features.does: A rider books a trip to another town with a fare that fairly covers the driver's return.

parts.name: Long trip fare
parts.what: A fare rule for long trips that can include part of the driver's return, set by vote.

parts.name: Long trip work time check
parts.what: Applies the stricter work time limits to fares over 100 km before the offer is made.

features.name: Ride to public transport
features.does: A rider plans a trip that combines a short ride with a bus, train or ferry.

parts.name: Public transport timetables
parts.what: Imports the open timetable feeds (GTFS) that NZ transport agencies publish, under their licence terms.

parts.name: Combined trip suggestions
parts.what: Suggests a ride to the right stop to meet a service, with total time and cost.

features.name: Child car seats
features.does: A rider travelling with a young child asks for a car with the right child seat.

parts.name: Child seat rules
parts.what: What the law requires for children in passenger service vehicles and what drivers may supply.

parts.name: Child seat equipment
parts.what: Records child seats fitted to a vehicle and matches them to requests.

features.name: Same fare for my regular trip
features.does: A rider who makes the same trip often fixes its fare for a period, with no subscription charge.

parts.name: Regular trip fare
parts.what: A fixed fare for a regular route and time window, set by the drivers' vote and charged per trip with no monthly fee.

areas.name: The live trip
areas.summary: From the moment a driver accepts to the moment the rider gets out: who is coming, where they are, waiting, starting and ending the trip, changes on the way, and keeping going through lost signal.

features.name: Driver on the way
features.does: A rider sees the driver's name, photo, car, plate and rating, and watches the car arrive with a live arrival time.

parts.name: Trip position sharing
parts.what: Decides which driver positions the rider sees, from acceptance to drop-off only, sent over the kit's live location stream.

parts.name: Trip map
parts.what: Shows the car, the route and the pickup point, updating smoothly.

parts.name: Driver card
parts.what: Name, photo, car, colour, plate and rating, with buttons to message, call and share the trip.

parts.name: Live arrival time
parts.what: Recalculates the arrival time as the car moves.

features.name: Arrival and waiting
features.does: The rider is told when the car arrives; a short free wait applies, then a published waiting charge.

parts.name: Arrival detection
parts.what: Marks the driver as arrived when they reach the pickup point or tap arrived.

parts.name: Wait timer
parts.what: Counts free wait time, then waiting charges, shown to both sides, with a longer free wait and no charges for riders who need more time to board.

parts.name: Arrival notice
parts.what: Push and text when the car arrives and again before charges start.

features.name: Start and end the trip
features.does: The driver starts the trip after checking the rider and ends it at the destination; both see the same route and fare.

parts.name: Trip commands
parts.what: Start, end and no-show as commands on the marketplace loop.

parts.name: Trip record
parts.what: The full record of a trip: times, route trace, fare version, people and vehicle, kept as the rules require.

parts.name: Trip summary
parts.what: Shows both sides the route, time, distance and final fare when the trip ends.

features.name: Change the destination or add a stop
features.does: A rider changes where they are going during the trip and sees the new fare before it applies.

parts.name: In-trip change command
parts.what: Ride's destination changes and added stops on the kit's order changes, with the driver told, the fare re-quoted and the hold raised.

parts.name: In-trip change screen
parts.what: Edit destination or stops and confirm the new fare.

features.name: Keeps going through lost signal
features.does: If either phone loses signal, the trip carries on and catches up when the signal is back.

parts.name: Offline trip state
parts.what: Keeps the trip state on the phone and replays it to the server when back online.

parts.name: Route trace buffer
parts.what: Stores GPS points on the phone while offline so the distance and fare are still right.

parts.name: Trace reconciliation
parts.what: Rebuilds the distance from a patchy trace by matching it to roads.

features.name: No-show
features.does: A driver who waited the full time marks a no-show and is paid the published fee.

parts.name: No-show rule
parts.what: When a no-show can be marked and what it costs, checked against the driver's location, and only once any longer wait a rider needs has passed.

features.name: After the trip
features.does: A rider and driver each rate the trip, the rider can tip, and both get their receipt or earnings.

parts.name: After-trip screen
parts.what: Rating, tip and a link to the receipt or earnings, all optional.

features.name: Past trips and ride again
features.does: A rider or driver lists their past trips, opens any one for its map, fare, receipt and help, and books the same trip again in one tap.

parts.name: Trip history
parts.what: Past trips for riders and drivers with map, fare and receipt, the starting point for help, lost items, fare reviews and disputes.

parts.name: Ride again
parts.what: Books the same trip, or the trip back, in one tap at today's quoted fare.

features.name: A driver who speaks my language
features.does: A rider sees the languages their driver speaks and can prefer a driver who shares their language.

parts.name: Driver languages
parts.what: Shows the languages a driver speaks on the driver card, and lets a rider prefer, but not require, a driver who shares their language.

areas.name: The driver's working day
areas.summary: What a driver does from going online to going home: choosing what they drive, seeing full offers, accepting or declining freely, breaks and work time limits, earnings and where riders are waiting.

features.name: Go online and offline
features.does: A driver goes online with one tap and offline whenever they like.

parts.name: Online state
parts.what: Ride's online, on trip and on break states, as operations on the kit's worker availability.

parts.name: Location while online
parts.what: Sends the driver's location every few seconds only while online, and never when offline.

parts.name: Driver home screen
parts.what: Online switch, today's earnings, work time left and the map.

features.name: See the whole offer
features.does: A driver sees the pickup distance, destination, fare, the at-cost fee and their earnings before deciding.

parts.name: Offer card
parts.what: Shows pickup time, trip length, destination area, passengers and bags, rider rating, needs, fare, fee and earnings, readable at a glance and accepted with one tap, and never the rider's name or photo, which appear only once the driver accepts.

parts.name: Offer alerts
parts.what: Sound, vibration and a flash for each offer, each one adjustable.

features.name: Accept or decline with no penalty
features.does: A driver accepts or declines any offer and declining never lowers their standing or future offers.

parts.name: Accept and decline commands
parts.what: Accept, decline and let-expire as commands, taken only from the signed-in driver's own app, with no score kept against declines.

parts.name: No-penalty rule
parts.what: Writes into the published dispatch rules that declines and acceptance rates never affect offers.

features.name: Choose where and what to drive
features.does: A driver sets areas, ride options, the longest pickup they will take, pets, shared rides and trip lengths.

parts.name: Driver preferences
parts.what: The driver's standing choices, used as filters by dispatch.

parts.name: Driver preferences screen
parts.what: Simple settings with a map to draw or pick areas.

features.name: Heading home
features.does: A driver asks for trips that head toward a chosen place, as often as they like.

parts.name: Destination filter
parts.what: Offers only trips that bring the driver closer to their chosen place by road time.

features.name: Breaks and work time limits
features.does: A driver sees work time left, is warned before a limit, is stopped from taking offers when a rest is due, and their logbook keeps itself.

parts.name: Passenger work time rules
parts.what: Ride's NZ work time rules for passenger drivers on the kit's work-time limits, counting all paid work and not only Spare Ride time: continuous work, daily and cumulative limits and rest breaks.

parts.name: Electronic logbook
parts.what: Records work time as an electronic logbook built to NZTA's approval rules, so drivers need no paper logbook.

parts.name: Break reminders
parts.what: Warnings before a rest is due and a clear rest-break screen.

parts.name: Logbook export
parts.what: Shows and exports the logbook for an enforcement officer or the driver.

parts.name: Other work entries
parts.what: The driver records time on other paid work, such as another ride app or a day job, so the limits and the logbook count it.

parts.name: Work time from other Spareware apps
parts.what: Counts time the same person worked in other Spareware apps, such as Spare Food deliveries, through the kit's shared worker record, so nobody types it twice.

parts.name: Logbook approval
parts.what: Gets NZTA's approval for the electronic logbook before drivers rely on it, with what the approval asks for.

features.name: Where riders are waiting
features.does: A driver sees a map of where riders are waiting now, with no bonuses that push them around.

parts.name: Demand map service

parts.name: Demand map layer
parts.what: Shows busy areas on the driver's map.

features.name: Today's earnings
features.does: A driver sees what they earned today, this week and per trip, and what the fee paid for.

parts.name: Earnings screen
parts.what: Totals by day and week, each trip's fare, fee, tip and payout status.

features.name: What a trip really earns
features.does: A driver enters their vehicle costs and sees what each offer earns after fuel and wear.

parts.name: Vehicle cost model
parts.what: Works out a cost per kilometre from the driver's own figures, including road user charges for electric and diesel vehicles.

parts.name: Earnings after costs

features.name: Next trip lined up

parts.name: Chained offers
parts.what: Offers a trip that starts near the current drop-off before the trip ends.

features.name: Driver ID on screen

parts.name: Driver ID screen
parts.what: Shows the driver's photo, name, licence details and operator, as the rules allow it to be shown.

features.name: Driving mode
features.does: While the car moves, the driver app shows only what can be read at a glance, reads offers and messages aloud and locks typing, so drivers keep within the mobile phone rule.

parts.name: Phone rule for drivers
parts.what: What the Road User Rule lets a driver do with a mounted phone while driving, with sources, checked against each driver screen.

parts.name: Moving lock
parts.what: Detects when the car is moving and locks typing, chat and anything beyond one-tap controls until it stops.

parts.name: Read aloud
parts.what: Reads new offers, rider messages and area notices aloud with the phone's own voice.

features.name: Drive by voice
features.does: A driver accepts or declines an offer, marks arrival and sends a set reply by voice, without touching the phone.

parts.name: Voice commands for drivers
parts.what: Offer, arrival and reply commands spoken through the kit's voice control, as the same commands the screen uses.

areas.name: Dispatch and matching
areas.summary: How a request finds a driver: nearest by road time, offers that pass on, matching needs to vehicles, published rules with no hidden ranking, scheduled rides and fairness checks.

features.name: Nearest driver by road time
features.does: A rider's request goes first to the driver who can reach them soonest by road, not by straight-line distance.

parts.name: Candidate search
parts.what: Ride's matching rule for the kit's dispatch engine: finds drivers in nearby cells, then ranks them by road time.

features.name: Arrival estimates before booking
features.does: A rider sees how long a car will take before they book.

parts.name: Arrival estimate
parts.what: Shows pickup time before booking from the kit's arrival estimates and nearby free drivers, with driver positions blurred.

features.name: Offers that pass on
features.does: An offer waits a set time and then goes to the next driver, until someone accepts or the rider is told no one is free.

parts.name: Offer cascade
parts.what: Ride's offer timeout and stop rule on the kit's dispatch engine: one offer at a time, passed on until someone accepts or the rider is told.

parts.name: No driver found
parts.what: Tells the rider plainly and offers to try again, widen the search or schedule.

features.name: Published dispatch rules
features.does: Anyone can read exactly how trips are offered, and every trip records which version of the rules matched it.

parts.name: Dispatch rules document
parts.what: The rules in plain words and as settings, changed only by a drivers' vote.

parts.name: Rule versions on trips
parts.what: Stores the dispatch rule version with each match so any match can be explained later.

parts.name: Why did I get this trip
parts.what: Shows a driver why an offer came to them, and why others did not, from the stored rules.

features.name: Match the right car to each need
features.does: Requests for wheelchair access, pets, larger cars, child seats or other needs go only to drivers and vehicles that can meet them.

parts.name: Need and preference filters
parts.what: Filters candidates by vehicle rules, driver preferences, blocks and rider needs.

parts.name: Battery range check
parts.what: For electric cars, compares the range the driver sets when going online with the pickup and the trip plus a margin before a long offer, so nobody is stranded.

features.name: Scheduled rides find a driver
features.does: A scheduled ride is offered to drivers ahead of time, and the rider is told early if no one has taken it.

parts.name: Scheduled dispatch
parts.what: Offers scheduled rides ahead, reminds the driver, and falls back to live dispatch near pickup time.

parts.name: Scheduled ride reminders
parts.what: Reminders to rider and driver, and an early warning if no driver is confirmed.

parts.name: Scheduled trip board
parts.what: An open list where drivers pick scheduled and long trips themselves, alongside offers sent one at a time, under the same published rules.

features.name: Fair shares of work
features.does: The co-op checks that trips are shared fairly across drivers, areas and groups, and publishes the results.

parts.name: Fairness measures
parts.what: Measures offers and earnings across drivers and areas without exposing anyone.

parts.name: Fairness report
parts.what: A regular public report on the measures, published with the cost ledger.

parts.name: Decline pattern checks
parts.what: Looks for declines and cancellations clustering by suburb, destination, rider name or disability need, on the kit's decline pattern checks, and sends patterns to a person, never acting on a single decline.

features.name: Busy-time forecasts
features.does: Drivers see when and where demand is likely to rise, so they can choose when to work.

parts.name: Forecast methods
parts.what: Proven open methods for short-term demand forecasts from trip history.

parts.name: Forecast service
parts.what: Produces forecasts by area and hour for the driver app.

features.name: City rules as plugins
features.does: A city's drivers vote to change how offers are scored, and the change runs as a checked plugin.

parts.name: Scoring plugins
parts.what: Dispatch scoring as sandboxed plugins with declared inputs, swapped only after a vote.

features.name: Replay past days before a change
features.does: The co-op replays past days of real requests through a proposed dispatch rule and compares wait times and earnings before members vote.

parts.name: Dispatch replay
parts.what: Replays past days of requests through a new rule version and compares wait times and earnings.

features.name: When a driver cancels
features.does: If a driver cancels after accepting, the rider is told why in plain words and goes to the front of the queue for the next driver at the same fare.

parts.name: Re-match first
parts.what: Puts the rider back at the front of dispatch with the same quote and tells them what happened.

parts.name: Driver cancel reasons
parts.what: The reasons a driver can give that never count against them, such as too many passengers, no child seat, a child riding alone or a safety worry, and what the rider sees.

areas.name: Fares and pricing
areas.summary: How a fare is set, quoted, broken down and explained: a published formula drivers vote on, the at-cost fee from the ledger, extras, changes during a trip and any busy-time pricing.

features.name: Fare formula set by drivers
features.does: Drivers vote on a published fare formula of a base fare, a rate per kilometre, a rate per minute and a minimum fare.

parts.name: Fare formula design
parts.what: How the formula is set, shown and changed, with worked examples, within what competition law allows.

parts.name: Fare formula
parts.what: Calculates a fare from distance, time and the voted rates, the same on server and phone.

parts.name: Formula versions
parts.what: Every formula version stored with its vote and start date, and linked from each trip.

features.name: Upfront quote
features.does: A rider gets a firm fare before booking from the expected route and time.

parts.name: Quote service
parts.what: Prices the expected route for each ride option and signs the quote so it cannot be changed.

features.name: Breakdown on every fare
features.does: Every fare shows the driver's share, the at-cost fee, the payment fee and GST.

parts.name: Breakdown calculator
parts.what: Splits a fare into driver share, fee, payment fee and GST, to the cent.

parts.name: At-cost fee
parts.what: Applies Spare Ride's fee for the period, set by the kit's fee setting from the last period's running cost divided by trips.

parts.name: Who pays the fee
parts.what: Whether the rider or the driver pays the at-cost fee, and what that means for GST on the fee and tax invoices for GST-registered drivers.

parts.name: Who sells the ride
parts.what: Settles on the kit's seller of record rule whether the co-op or the driver sells each ride, which sets whose name is on the receipt, who owes consumer guarantees and how tax invoices read.

parts.name: Payment fee and surcharge rules
parts.what: Checks that the payment fee line on every fare is not a card surcharge that NZ's planned ban forbids for in-app payments, on the kit's card fee pass-through check.

features.name: Busy-time pricing
features.does: Riders see any busy-time price before booking, and it only exists if drivers voted for it, within a voted cap.

parts.name: Busy-time rule
parts.what: A capped multiplier that switches on from published demand measures, or not at all.

parts.name: Busy-time notice
parts.what: Shows the multiplier, why it is on and the cap, before the rider books.

features.name: Extras
features.does: Tolls, airport fees, waiting time and cleaning charges are added by published rules and shown on the receipt.

parts.name: Toll and airport fee data
parts.what: Toll roads and airport charges with their prices, kept up to date from NZTA and each airport and matched to the route.

parts.name: Extras rules
parts.what: Adds tolls, airport fees and waiting charges to a fare, and passes them straight through.

parts.name: Cleaning claim
parts.what: A driver claims a cleaning charge with photos on the kit's extra charges after the job; the rider can dispute it.

features.name: Fare changes during a trip
features.does: If the route, stops or destination change, the fare changes by a published rule the rider can check.

parts.name: Fare adjustment rules
parts.what: When a fare stays fixed, when it is re-quoted and by how much it may move.

parts.name: Route check
parts.what: Compares the trace with the quoted route to spot long detours and fix the fare.

features.name: Cancellation and no-show fees
features.does: Cancellation and no-show fees follow published rules, and go to the driver who lost the time.

parts.name: Cancellation rules
parts.what: Free window, fee and who gets it, for riders and drivers alike.

features.name: Explain any past fare
features.does: A rider or driver taps any past trip and sees exactly how its fare was worked out.

parts.name: Fare explainer
parts.what: Replays a trip's stored formula version and inputs to show every step.

parts.name: Fare explanation screen
parts.what: The steps of the fare in plain words.

features.name: Fares per city
features.does: Drivers in each city set their own fare formula.

parts.name: Regional fares
parts.what: Formula settings per service area, each with its own vote.

areas.name: Payments, tips and payouts
areas.summary: How money moves: riders pay through a regulated payment provider, the fare is held then taken, tips go untouched to the driver, refunds and failed payments are handled, and drivers are paid out daily.

features.name: Add a way to pay
features.does: A rider adds a card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, entered on the payment provider's own form.

parts.name: Payment method screens
parts.what: Add, remove and pick a default card or wallet in Spare Ride, using the kit's checkout and saved payment methods.

features.name: Pay and hold
features.does: The fare is held when a driver accepts and taken when the trip ends, so riders are never charged for a trip that did not happen.

parts.name: Hold and capture
parts.what: Places a hold for the quoted fare when a driver accepts and captures the final fare at the end, using the kit's hold and release rules.

parts.name: Hold top-up
parts.what: Raises the hold when the fare rises from new stops, a new destination, waiting or tolls, and asks the rider for another card if the larger hold fails.

features.name: Tips
features.does: A rider adds a tip during or after the trip and all of it goes to the driver.

parts.name: Tip flow
parts.what: Tip amounts, custom tips and a time limit, passed to the driver with no fee taken.

parts.name: Card fee on tips
parts.what: A published rule, set by vote, on whether the rider adds the card fee on a tip or the running costs cover it; it is never taken from the driver's tip.

features.name: Split a fare
features.does: Riders sharing a car split the fare in the app, each paying their share.

parts.name: Fare split
parts.what: Sends a split request to friends and charges each their share once they accept.

features.name: Pay by bank
features.does: A rider pays straight from their bank account.

parts.name: Bank payments research
parts.what: Whether NZ open banking payments suit rides and which providers support them.

features.name: Cash
features.does: A rider pays the driver in cash where members decide to allow it.

parts.name: Cash rules
parts.what: Whether cash fits the registered passenger rule, GST collection and driver safety.

features.name: Ride credit and gift vouchers
features.does: A person buys ride credit or a gift voucher for someone else.

parts.name: Ride vouchers
parts.what: Ride credit and vouchers for a set amount or a named rider, redeemed at payment, on the kit's gift cards.

parts.name: Voucher terms
parts.what: Vouchers stay valid for at least three years, as the Fair Trading Act has required since 16 March 2026, and ride credit is paid back or kept when an account closes.

features.name: Refunds and corrections
features.does: A rider gets a refund or a corrected fare when a review finds they were overcharged.

parts.name: Refund command
parts.what: Ride refunds and fare corrections on the kit's refunds, with the reason recorded and the driver's share handled by the clawback rules.

features.name: Receipts and tax invoices
features.does: A rider gets a receipt for every trip that is also a valid GST tax invoice.

parts.name: Receipt maker
parts.what: Ride receipts on the kit's receipts and tax invoices, showing who sold the ride, the fare breakdown, the route, the driver's identification details and the vehicle's registration number.

parts.name: Receipt delivery
parts.what: Sends receipts by email and keeps them in the trip history.

features.name: Daily payouts
features.does: A driver is paid out every day with no fee beyond what the provider charges.

parts.name: Driver earnings ledger
parts.what: Every fare, tip, fee and payout for a driver, as operations that add up exactly.

features.name: Instant payout
features.does: A driver cashes out now, paying only the provider's cost.

parts.name: Instant payout
parts.what: Sends a payout on demand, passing the provider's charge through at cost.

features.name: Failed payments and chargebacks
features.does: The app handles declined cards and chargebacks fairly, using the trip record as evidence.

parts.name: Failed payment handling
parts.what: Retries, tells the rider, and holds new bookings until the balance is paid.

parts.name: Chargeback evidence for trips
parts.what: Sends the trip record, route and fare steps to the kit's card dispute handling, and keeps the driver paid when the trip was real.

features.name: Money owed after a payout
features.does: When a refund, chargeback or fare correction comes after a driver was paid, the driver sees what is owed and repays it fairly from later earnings.

parts.name: Ride clawback rules
parts.what: Ride's voted limits on the kit's loss rules: when a driver's share can be taken back, the most taken from any one payout, and which errors the co-op pays for itself.

parts.name: Ride balance recovery
parts.what: Recovers money a driver owes through the kit's negative balances, in small steps from later earnings and never from tips, shown on the earnings ledger.

parts.name: Ride fee invoices

parts.what: How tips, cancellation and no-show fees, waiting charges, tolls, airport fees and cleaning charges are treated for GST on listed services and in income reports to IRD, which is unverified.

features.name: Flat-rate credit statements
features.does: A driver who is not GST-registered gets a monthly statement of their flat-rate credits.

parts.name: Flat-rate credits for drivers
parts.what: Shows each month's flat-rate credits in the driver's earnings, from the kit's flat-rate credit notices, with a PDF copy.

features.name: Income reports to IRD
features.does: The platform reports each driver's income to IRD as the law requires and shows the driver what was sent.

parts.name: What we told IRD
parts.what: Shows each driver the figures reported about them.

features.name: Earnings statements
features.does: A driver downloads weekly, monthly and yearly earnings statements for their accountant or a lender.

parts.name: Weekly and monthly statements
parts.what: Weekly and monthly earnings statements as PDF and CSV for an accountant or a lender, alongside the kit's yearly statement.

features.name: Mileage and expenses log
features.does: A driver keeps a log of work kilometres and expenses, filled in from their trips, for their tax return.

parts.name: Work kilometre tracker
parts.what: Counts kilometres while online and on trips from the driver's own traces.

parts.name: Expense entry
parts.what: Add fuel, servicing and other costs with a photo of the receipt.

parts.name: Tax pack export
parts.what: One download of earnings, kilometres and expenses for the year.

features.name: Pay records if drivers are employees

parts.name: Ride pay inputs
parts.what: If drivers are employees, which Ride time counts as work, such as online, waiting and on trip, and how fares and tips feed pay under the kit's pay rules.

parts.name: Ride pay to payroll
parts.what: Sends Ride's worked time and earnings to the kit's payroll provider link and minimum pay top-up.

parts.name: Leave requests
parts.what: If drivers are employees, they ask for annual leave, sick leave and public holidays in the app, paid under the kit's holiday pay.

parts.name: Time and wage records
parts.what: If drivers are employees, keeps the time, wage, holiday and leave records employment law requires, from online and trip time.

parts.name: Availability terms
parts.what: If drivers are employees, how rosters or availability terms work, since going online at any time may not fit employment.

features.name: ACC and levies explained
features.does: A self-employed driver sees what ACC levies and other costs to expect and where to sort them.

parts.name: Ride's ACC page
parts.what: Shows self-employed drivers the kit's KiwiSaver, ACC and tax guidance in the driver help hub, with examples from ride work.

areas.name: Maps, routing and navigation

features.name: A map on every screen
features.does: A rider or driver sees a clear, fast map that works on cheap phones, with open map credits shown.

parts.name: Ride map layers
parts.what: Cars, pickup pins, routes and zones drawn on the kit's map display, light and dark.

features.name: Address and place search
features.does: A person finds any NZ address or place by name, in English or te reo Māori.

parts.name: Place names in two languages
parts.what: Matches places by their English and te reo Māori names.

features.name: Routes and travel times
features.does: The app works out the best road route and a realistic travel time for every quote, offer and trip.

parts.name: Ride trips for travel time learning
parts.what: Feeds finished Spare Ride trips into the kit's arrival time learning, anonymised first.

features.name: Turn-by-turn directions
features.does: A driver gets spoken turn-by-turn directions in the app, or opens the trip in another navigation app.

parts.name: Open in another app

features.name: Pickup and drop-off points

parts.name: Pickup point data
parts.what: Good stopping spots, no-stopping zones and entrances, from open data and driver reports.

parts.name: Pickup point finder

features.name: Service areas and zones

parts.name: Ride zones
parts.what: Airport zones, event zones and fare regions as versioned map shapes on top of the kit's service areas.

parts.name: Zone editor
parts.what: Draw and change areas and zones on a map, each change an operation.

parts.name: Pickup spot reports
parts.what: A driver reports a bad pickup spot, which updates Ride's pickup data; road mistakes go to the kit's map fix reports.

features.name: Offline maps
features.does: A driver downloads their city's map so directions still work in dead spots.

parts.name: Driver's city pack
parts.what: Keeps the map and routing pack for the driver's service area current on the phone, using the kit's offline map packs.

features.name: Road closures and events
features.does: Drivers and quotes take road closures and works into account.

parts.name: Road event feeds
parts.what: Imports official open road closure and works feeds, under their terms, into the kit's routing service.

parts.name: Closures on the map
parts.what: Shows closures and routes around them.

features.name: Find a charger
features.does: A driver with an electric car sees public chargers on the map.

parts.name: Charger map layer
parts.what: Shows public electric vehicle chargers on the driver's map from open charger data, under its licence terms.

areas.name: Messages, calls and notifications
areas.summary: How riders, drivers and the co-op reach each other: in-trip chat, calls that hide phone numbers, push, text and email, translation, and each person's choice of what reaches them.

features.name: Chat during a trip
features.does: A rider and driver message each other from booking until shortly after the trip ends.

parts.what: A trip chat on the kit's chat service that opens at booking and closes on its own after the trip.

parts.name: Quick replies
parts.what: One-tap messages such as "I'm here" and "Coming now", which a driver can send only when the car is stopped, or by voice.

features.name: Calls that hide numbers
features.does: A rider and driver call each other without seeing each other's phone number.

parts.name: Trip calls
parts.what: Masked calls between rider and driver from acceptance until shortly after the trip, and for lost items, on the kit's masked calls.

features.name: Push notifications
features.does: A rider or driver is told at once when something changes, even with the app closed.

parts.name: Notice catalogue

features.name: Text message updates

parts.what: Sends key trip updates by SMS when push fails or the rider has no app.

features.name: Email

parts.name: Email notices
parts.what: Plain, accessible emails for receipts, statements and account changes.

features.name: Choose what reaches me

parts.name: Ride notice choices
parts.what: Spare Ride's notice types added to the kit's notification settings, with safety and trip notices always on.

features.name: Messages in my language
features.does: A rider and driver who speak different languages see each other's messages translated.

parts.name: Trip chat translation

features.name: Co-op announcements

parts.name: Ride member notices
parts.what: Spare Ride's vote, fare change and ledger notices, sent to its members through the kit's co-op announcements.

features.name: Warned about trips off the app
features.does: A rider or driver is warned when chat drifts toward setting up a ride outside the app.

parts.name: Off-app trip warnings
parts.what: Warns both people when trip chat suggests a ride outside the app, such as a direct cash trip, using the kit's scam warnings, and explains what the rider loses.

features.name: Emergency button
features.does: A rider or driver calls emergency services from the app and sees their location, car and trip details to read out.

parts.what: Shows the plate, car, driver and trip large on the kit's emergency button, with the right number for the country.

parts.name: Safety team alert
parts.what: Tells the co-op's safety team at once when the emergency button is used.

parts.name: Help by text

features.name: Share my trip

parts.what: Shows the car, plate, route and arrival time on the kit's trusted contact link, ending when the trip ends.

parts.name: Trusted contacts

parts.name: Right car prompt
parts.what: Shows the plate, colour and driver photo large as the car arrives.

features.does: A driver takes a quick live selfie now and then so riders and the co-op know the account holder is the one driving.

features.name: Check-ins when something looks wrong

parts.what: Thresholds for long stops, big detours and early ends on ride trips, run by the kit's trip check-ins.

parts.name: Check-in prompt
parts.what: Asks if everything is OK, with quick routes to help or the emergency button.

features.name: Crash detection
features.does: The app notices a possible crash and offers help.

parts.name: Crash detection
parts.what: Watches phone sensors during trips and starts a check-in after a likely crash.

features.name: Safety preferences

parts.what: Rules that switch safety tools on by time or every trip.

parts.name: Women preferences and the law

parts.what: Matches women who opt in, using the gender each person states or their ID shows, never one guessed from a face.

parts.what: A short report form tied to the trip, with optional audio and photos.
